statement.domain: P-operators A:L^infinity(Omega)->L^1(Omega) on a Borel probability space
statement.self_adjoint: for all bounded measurable u,v, integral (Av)u dmu = integral (Au)v dmu
statement.positivity_preserving: for all v>=0 almost everywhere, Av>=0 almost everywhere

tested_instances: the original nonnegative symmetric 3-cell step graphon and sparse path P4
34 deterministic instances from six dense, sparse, bounded-degree, unbounded-degree, uniform-measure, and nonuniform reversible families
sizes through 16,384 vertices and 448,593,904 implicitly or explicitly certified operator cells

proof_scope.finite_atomic_certificate: For every finite dimension n, every strictly positive probability vector mu, and every real matrix A, basis witnesses prove self-adjointness iff mu_i A_ij = mu_j A_ji and positivity preservation iff every A_ij is nonnegative.
proof_scope.general_structural_argument: Coefficient comparison proves sufficiency and basis vectors prove necessity. This is an all-real-signal certificate, not enumeration over a selected grid.
proof_scope.graphon_scope: The dense family instantiates symmetric nonnegative step kernels. The source audit separately records the Fubini/Tonelli extension to bounded measurable symmetric nonnegative kernels.

acceptance: the necessary-and-sufficient coefficient certificate is machine checked
all family instances satisfy exact detailed balance and entrywise nonnegativity
the exact positive-operator norms are finite
an independent checker uses basis witnesses and closed-form degree/flow formulas without importing the primary verifier
asymmetric and negative-entry controls are rejected for their intended reasons
